hints: Use local transport when the agent or IDE assistant needs the full Python tool registry, including ROOT ingest and non-HEP verticals.
Call get_toolkit_descriptor(transport="local") first and treat descriptor.tools as the callable contract instead of hard-coding tool names.
For reproducible reviews, parity checks, and IDE quick-fixes, set execution.deterministic=true explicitly.

recipes.prompt: Audit this workspace, then fit it and report the POI value and uncertainty, a short asymptotic CLs summary, observed and expected 95% CL upper limit, and a short profile scan summary. If the workspace is pyhf or HS3, also include discovery significance and top nuisance impacts by default. If it is simplified-likelihood, treat audit + fit + asymptotic CLs/upper-limit + scan as the promoted stable subset and use discovery, ranking, or toy CLs only when the user explicitly asks for the compatibility-tested surface. Use deterministic mode.
recipes.summary: Audit a workspace, fit it, and produce CLs, upper-limit, and scan outputs in-process. For simplified-likelihood inputs, discovery, ranking, and toy CLs remain compatibility-tested rather than promoted stable.
recipes.title: Local HEP workspace inference

recipes.prompt: Read the requested ROOT histograms locally, summarize suspicious bins and under or overflow content, then continue with deterministic workspace validation and fit checks.
recipes.summary: Read TH1 histograms locally, then use the regular HEP inference tools on the derived workspace.
recipes.title: Local ROOT ingest and workspace triage

recipes.prompt: Fit the requested generalized linear model, then if posterior uncertainty is important run Bayesian sampling locally and summarize posterior means plus convergence diagnostics rather than dumping raw chains by default.
recipes.summary: Use the local Python surface for generalized linear models and Bayesian posterior sampling.
recipes.title: Local Bayesian and GLM analysis

recipes.prompt: Fit the requested survival or competing-risks model, include Kaplan-Meier or direct log-rank summaries when appropriate, and report synthetic or validated churn datasets, Cox PH churn-risk outputs, bootstrap hazard-ratio uncertainty summaries, retention curves, cohort life-table matrices, trust-gate diagnostics, pairwise churn-comparison outputs, bounded uplift estimates, or survival-native uplift summaries with deterministic settings.
recipes.summary: Run survival, Kaplan-Meier, direct log-rank, competing-risks, synthetic churn generation, churn-risk modeling, ingest, bootstrap HR, diagnostics, cohort-matrix, and retention/comparison workflows locally through the Python tool registry.
recipes.title: Local survival and risk analysis

recipes.prompt: Run the requested ads variance-reduction adjustment deterministically, keep covariates strictly pre-treatment, and report adjusted means, treatment effect, variance-reduction diagnostics, selected covariates, provenance validation, and solver metadata.
recipes.summary: Run deterministic CUPED or CURE adjustment locally through the ads-native Python helpers with provenance-aware leakage validation.
recipes.title: Local ads variance reduction

recipes.prompt: Pick the right econometric tool for the identification strategy, run the model deterministically, and summarize treatment effects, event-study dynamics, volatility behavior, or state-space forecasts as appropriate.
recipes.summary: Use the local surface for panel, DiD, IV, doubly robust causal inference, event studies, volatility, and Kalman workflows.
recipes.title: Local econometrics and time-series workflows

recipes.prompt: Run the requested meta-analysis, reserving, or fault-tree simulation locally and return the key pooled estimate, reserve view, or rare-event risk metrics with deterministic settings where applicable.
recipes.summary: Cover meta-analysis, chain-ladder reserving, and reliability or fault-tree Monte Carlo workflows locally.
recipes.title: Local meta-analysis, reserving, and reliability

recipes.prompt: Fit the requested population PK or dose-response workflow locally, run the follow-up GOF, NPDE, VPC, simulation, or bioequivalence step when relevant, and summarize the main parameter estimates and diagnostics.
recipes.summary: Fit PopPK models, run GOF, NPDE, or VPC diagnostics and trial simulations, evaluate bioequivalence, and work with dose-response models locally.
recipes.title: Local pharma, trial simulation, and dose response

function.description: Run Maximum Likelihood Estimation (MLE) on a HistFactory statistical model; simplified-likelihood input is inside the promoted March 2026 stable subset. Returns best-fit parameters, uncertainties, NLL at minimum, and convergence info. The workspace_json must be a pyhf-style, HS3-style, or simplified-likelihood JSON workspace string.
function.name: nextstat_fit

execution.description: Optional execution controls. If deterministic=true (default), NextStat will attempt to enforce parity-friendly settings (threads=1, eval_mode='parity') where supported.

deterministic.description: If true, prefer deterministic parity behavior (default: true).

eval_mode.description: Evaluation mode. 'parity' favors numerical stability; 'fast' may use approximations.

threads.description: Requested thread count. If omitted and deterministic=true, defaults to 1. If 0, use library default.

workspace_json.description: JSON string of the pyhf, HS3, or simplified-likelihood workspace. Auto-detected.

function.description: Run an asymptotic CLs hypothesis test at a given signal strength mu (qtilde); simplified-likelihood input is inside the promoted March 2026 stable subset. Returns CLs, CLs+b, and CLb (pyhf/HS3/simplified-likelihood-compatible semantics).
function.name: nextstat_hypotest

execution.description: Optional execution controls. If deterministic=true (default), NextStat will attempt to enforce parity-friendly settings (threads=1, eval_mode='parity') where supported.

deterministic.description: If true, prefer deterministic parity behavior (default: true).

eval_mode.description: Evaluation mode. 'parity' favors numerical stability; 'fast' may use approximations.

mu.description: Signal strength hypothesis to test (e.g. 1.0 for SM).

workspace_json.description: JSON string of the pyhf, HS3, or simplified-likelihood workspace.

function.description: Compute nuisance parameter ranking (systematic impact on signal strength); simplified-likelihood input is compatibility-tested but outside the promoted March 2026 stable subset. For simplified-likelihood, entries rank reduced nuisance coordinates from the compiled model rather than source-level systematics; covariance-form and derived_from_workspace inputs do not preserve original nuisance identities. Returns a sorted list of impacts (delta_mu_up, delta_mu_down), pull values, and constraints. This is the physics equivalent of Feature Importance only when nuisance names still map to source-level systematics.
function.name: nextstat_ranking

top_n.description: Return only the top N most impactful systematics. Default: all.

workspace_json.description: JSON string of the pyhf, HS3, or simplified-likelihood workspace.

function.description: Read a TH1 histogram from a ROOT file, including sumw2 and under/overflow bins. Returns bin edges, bin content, and flow bins for downstream analysis.
function.name: nextstat_read_root_histogram

execution.description: Optional execution controls. If deterministic=true (default), NextStat will attempt to enforce parity-friendly settings (threads=1, eval_mode='parity') where supported.

deterministic.description: If true, prefer deterministic parity behavior (default: true).

eval_mode.description: Evaluation mode. 'parity' favors numerical stability; 'fast' may use approximations.

filename_hint.description: Optional filename hint used for diagnostics when reading ROOT bytes from memory.

hist_path.description: Histogram path/key inside the ROOT file (e.g. 'dir/hist').

root_bytes_base64.description: Base64-encoded ROOT file bytes. Use this when the histogram source is already in memory rather than on local disk.

root_path.description: Path to a ROOT file on local disk.

function.description: Fit a Generalized Linear Model (GLM). Supports linear, logistic, Poisson, and negative binomial regression. Returns coefficients, standard errors, and predictions. Input is tabular: X (2D array of features), y (1D array of outcomes).
function.name: nextstat_glm_fit

include_intercept.description: Whether to include an intercept term. Default: true.

x.description: Feature matrix (2D array, each inner array is one observation).

function.description: Run Bayesian NUTS sampling on supported NextStat models and return a bounded summary: parameter names, convergence diagnostics, and posterior mean summaries rather than raw posterior draws.
function.name: nextstat_bayesian_sample

model_type.description: Type of model to sample from.

n_levels.description: Number of ordinal levels (ordered logit/probit only).

n_samples.description: Number of post-warmup samples per chain. Default: 1000.

n_warmup.description: Number of warmup iterations per chain. Default: 500.

target_accept.description: Target acceptance rate for NUTS. Default: 0.8.

function.description: Fit a survival model via MLE. Supports Cox PH, Weibull, Log-Normal AFT, and Exponential models. Returns parameter estimates (log-hazard ratios or AFT coefficients), standard errors, and NLL. Input: X (covariates), time (event/censoring times), event (1=event, 0=censored).
function.name: nextstat_survival_fit

function.description: Compute the Kaplan-Meier survival curve and optionally a log-rank test. Returns time points, survival probabilities, confidence intervals, and number at risk. If group labels are provided, also returns a log-rank test.
function.name: nextstat_kaplan_meier

group.description: Optional group labels for log-rank test (e.g. 0/1 for two arms).

function.description: Run a direct log-rank (Mantel-Cox) test across two or more survival groups. Returns the chi-squared statistic, p-value, degrees of freedom, and per-group observed versus expected event totals.
function.name: nextstat_log_rank_test

events.description: Event indicators. Accepts booleans or 0/1 integers.

groups.description: Integer group labels for the survival comparison.

times.description: Observation times from event or censoring follow-up.

function.description: Fit a panel data model with entity fixed effects (within estimator). Returns coefficients with cluster-robust standard errors. Equivalent to Stata's xtreg, fe.
function.name: nextstat_panel_fe

time.description: Optional time identifiers (required for cluster='time' or 'two_way').

function.description: Estimate a Difference-in-Differences (DiD) model via two-way fixed effects (TWFE). Returns the ATT (average treatment effect on the treated) with cluster-robust SE.
function.name: nextstat_did

function.description: Estimate an Instrumental Variables (IV) model via Two-Stage Least Squares (2SLS). Returns structural coefficients, standard errors (homoskedastic, HC1, cluster-robust, or HAC), and first-stage F-statistics for weak instrument diagnostics.
function.name: nextstat_iv_2sls

max_lag.description: Maximum Newey-West lag when cov='hac'. Default: automatic.

function.description: Estimate a doubly-robust Average Treatment Effect (ATE or ATT) via Augmented Inverse Probability Weighting (AIPW). Returns the estimand, treatment effect estimate, standard error, and observation count.
function.name: nextstat_aipw

estimand.description: Estimand: ATE or ATT. Default: ate.

function.description: Run a meta-analysis (fixed or random effects). Input: effect sizes and their standard errors from multiple studies. Returns pooled estimate, confidence interval, heterogeneity statistics (I², Q, tau²).
function.name: nextstat_meta_analysis

standard_errors.description: Standard errors of each study's effect.

function.description: Run Kalman filtering, smoothing, forecasting, simulation, or bounded EM re-estimation on a linear state-space model. Returns state estimates, forecast intervals when requested, simulation paths, or re-estimated matrices depending on the selected operation.
function.name: nextstat_kalman

alpha.description: Two-sided forecast interval alpha in (0,1). Used when operation='forecast'.

estimate_f.description: Whether EM should re-estimate F. Currently meaningful for 1D models only. Default: false.

estimate_h.description: Whether EM should re-estimate H. Currently meaningful for 1D models only. Default: false.

estimate_q.description: Whether EM should re-estimate Q. Default: true.

estimate_r.description: Whether EM should re-estimate R. Default: true.

init.description: Initial state strategy for simulation when simulate_x0 is omitted. Default: sample.

max_iter.description: Maximum EM iterations when operation='em'. Default: 50.

min_diag.description: Minimum covariance diagonal floor used by EM. Default: 1e-12.

n_ahead.description: Number of steps to forecast ahead (forecast mode only). Default: 10.

seed.description: Random seed used for simulation. Default: 42.

simulate_x0.description: Optional override for the simulated initial state mean. Used when operation='simulate'.

t_max.description: Number of simulated time steps when operation='simulate'.

tol.description: Relative tolerance for EM convergence. Default: 1e-6.

y.description: Observation sequence (each element is an observation vector).

function.description: Apply one-covariate CUPED adjustment as the one-covariate case of the shared CURE layer. Only pre-treatment covariates are supported. Returns adjusted means, effect, variance-reduction diagnostics, selected covariates, provenance validation, and solver metadata.
function.name: nextstat_ads_cuped_adjust

control_covariates.description: One pre-treatment covariate value per control observation.

covariate_name.description: Optional human-readable covariate name for logging and artifact surfaces.

covariate_provenance.description: Optional typed provenance metadata for fail-fast leakage validation. timing must remain pre_treatment for promoted production use.

pre_treatment_only.description: Keep fail-fast pre-treatment-only validation enabled. Default: true.

variant_covariates.description: One pre-treatment covariate value per variant observation.

function.description: Apply multivariate CURE adjustment with SVD/ridge collinearity guardrails. Only pre-treatment covariates are supported. Returns adjusted means, effect, variance-reduction diagnostics, selected covariates, provenance validation, and solver metadata.
function.name: nextstat_ads_cure_adjust

covariate_names.description: Optional selected covariate names for logging and artifact surfaces.

covariate_provenance.description: Optional typed provenance metadata, one item per covariate, for fail-fast leakage validation.

pre_treatment_only.description: Keep fail-fast pre-treatment-only validation enabled. Default: true.

function.description: Generate a seeded synthetic churn dataset with customer-level times, events, groups, treatments, covariates, and segment metadata.
function.name: nextstat_churn_generate_data

n_cohorts.description: Number of synthetic signup cohorts. Default: 6.

n_customers.description: Number of synthetic customers to generate. Default: 2000.

treatment_fraction.description: Fraction of generated customers assigned to treatment. Default: 0.3.

function.description: Fit a Cox PH churn risk model and return log-hazard coefficients, standard errors, hazard ratios, and confidence intervals for the requested covariates.
function.name: nextstat_churn_risk_model

conf_level.description: Confidence level used for hazard-ratio confidence intervals. Default: 0.95.

covariates.description: Rectangular covariate matrix with one row per observation.

events.description: Churn indicators. Accepts booleans or 0/1 integers.

names.description: Covariate names matching the covariate column count.

times.description: Observation times from signup to churn or censoring.

function.description: Compute churn retention using stratified Kaplan-Meier summaries and a log-rank comparison. Returns the overall survival curve, per-group retention summaries, and the log-rank test.
function.name: nextstat_churn_retention

conf_level.description: Confidence level used for the Kaplan-Meier summaries. Default: 0.95.

events.description: Churn indicators. Accepts booleans or 0/1 integers.

groups.description: Group labels for stratified retention summaries and the log-rank comparison.

times.description: Observation times from signup to event or censoring.

function.description: Compare churn segments with pairwise log-rank tests, hazard-ratio proxies, and multiple-comparisons correction. Returns overall and pairwise segment-comparison diagnostics.
function.name: nextstat_churn_compare

alpha.description: Significance threshold used to mark pairwise results as significant. Default: 0.05.

conf_level.description: Confidence level used for median retention summaries. Default: 0.95.

correction.description: Multiple-testing correction method. Accepts 'benjamini_hochberg' (alias 'bh') or 'bonferroni'. Default: benjamini_hochberg.

events.description: Churn indicators. Accepts booleans or 0/1 integers.

groups.description: Segment labels for the pairwise churn comparison.

times.description: Observation times from signup to event or censoring.

function.description: Run churn-analysis trust-gate diagnostics: censoring rates by segment, covariate balance, optional propensity-overlap checks, and warning summaries for downstream retention or uplift analysis.
function.name: nextstat_churn_diagnostics

covariate_names.description: Optional covariate names aligned with the covariate matrix columns.

covariates.description: Optional rectangular numeric covariate matrix for balance and propensity-overlap diagnostics.

events.description: Churn indicators. Accepts booleans or 0/1 integers.

groups.description: Segment labels used for censoring-rate diagnostics.

times.description: Observation times from signup to event or censoring.

treated.description: Optional treatment indicators for propensity-overlap diagnostics. Accepts booleans or 0/1 integers.

trim.description: Propensity trimming threshold when overlap diagnostics are enabled. Default: 0.01.

function.description: Build a churn cohort life-table matrix. Returns per-cohort and overall retention periods with at-risk counts, events, censoring, retention rate, and cumulative retention.
function.name: nextstat_churn_cohort_matrix

events.description: Churn indicators. Accepts booleans or 0/1 integers.

groups.description: Cohort labels used to build the retention matrix.

period_boundaries.description: Sorted period-end time points used to define life-table buckets.

times.description: Observation times from signup to event or censoring.

function.description: Bootstrap hazard ratios from a churn Cox PH model. Returns per-covariate point estimates, confidence intervals, convergence counts, CI diagnostics, and bounded bootstrap metadata.
function.name: nextstat_churn_bootstrap_hr

covariates.description: Rectangular customer-level covariate matrix used in the Cox PH refits.

events.description: Churn indicators. Accepts booleans or 0/1 integers.

n_bootstrap.description: Number of bootstrap refits. Local Python keeps the raw default of 1000.

n_jackknife.description: Requested jackknife refits for BCa acceleration. Ignored for percentile intervals.

names.description: Covariate names matching the covariate column count.

times.description: Observation times from signup to event or censoring.

function.description: Validate and ingest raw churn arrays into a clean bounded dataset. Drops invalid rows, applies optional observation-end censoring, and returns normalized times, events, groups, treatment flags, covariates, and warnings.
function.name: nextstat_churn_ingest

covariate_names.description: Optional covariate names matching the covariate column count.

events.description: Churn indicators. Accepts booleans or 0/1 integers.

groups.description: Optional segment or cohort labels. When omitted, the underlying churn ingest uses its default grouping.

observation_end.description: Optional censoring cap; times above this threshold are clipped and marked censored.

times.description: Raw observation times from signup to event or censoring.

treated.description: Optional treatment indicators. Accepts booleans or 0/1 integers.

function.description: Estimate bounded churn uplift with the promoted AIPW workflow: treatment effect on churn within a time horizon, standard error, confidence interval, and sensitivity summary.
function.name: nextstat_churn_uplift

covariates.description: Rectangular numeric covariate matrix used for the propensity model.

events.description: Churn indicators. Accepts booleans or 0/1 integers.

horizon.description: Time horizon defining churn within horizon. Default: 12.0.

times.description: Observation times from signup to event or censoring.

treated.description: Treatment indicators. Accepts booleans or 0/1 integers.

function.description: Estimate survival-native churn uplift with RMST, IPW-weighted survival differences at specified horizons, and overlap diagnostics.
function.name: nextstat_churn_uplift_survival

covariates.description: Optional rectangular numeric covariate matrix used for the propensity model.

eval_horizons.description: Horizons where survival differences should be reported.

events.description: Churn indicators. Accepts booleans or 0/1 integers.

times.description: Observation times from signup to event or censoring.

treated.description: Treatment indicators. Accepts booleans or 0/1 integers.

function.description: Run chain ladder or Mack chain ladder reserving on a cumulative claims triangle. Accepts either a ragged upper-left triangle or a null-filled square triangle and returns development factors, ultimates, IBNR, and (for Mack) uncertainty metrics.
function.name: nextstat_chain_ladder

conf_level.description: Confidence level for Mack prediction intervals. Default: 0.95.

method.description: basic = deterministic chain ladder; mack = with prediction errors. Default: mack.

triangle.description: Cumulative claims triangle as either a ragged upper-left triangle or a null-filled square matrix. In square form, only the upper-left triangle is used.

function.description: Fit a nonlinear mixed-effects (NLME) population PK model using FOCE, FOCEI, FO, or SAEM. Supports 1/2/3-compartment models with IV or oral absorption. Returns population parameters (theta), random-effect standard deviations (omega), individual ETAs, OFV, and convergence info.
function.name: nextstat_pharma_fit

doses.description: Per-subject dose amounts (length = n_subjects, or length 1 for broadcast).

execution.description: Optional execution controls. If deterministic=true (default), NextStat will attempt to enforce parity-friendly settings (threads=1, eval_mode='parity') where supported.

deterministic.description: If true, prefer deterministic parity behavior (default: true).

eval_mode.description: Evaluation mode. 'parity' favors numerical stability; 'fast' may use approximations.

threads.description: Requested thread count. If omitted and deterministic=true, defaults to 1. If 0, use library default.

omega_init.description: Initial omega diagonal elements (IIV standard deviations).

sigma_add.description: Additive residual error magnitude. Required when error_model='combined'.

theta_init.description: Initial population PK parameter estimates (e.g. [Ka, CL, V] for 1cpt_oral).

times.description: Flat array of observation times across all subjects.

y.description: Flat array of observed concentrations (same length as times).

function.description: Run a Visual Predictive Check (VPC) for a fitted population PK model. Simulates replicate datasets, bins observations in time, and returns observed and simulated quantile envelopes for visual comparison.
function.name: nextstat_pharma_vpc

doses.description: Per-subject dose amounts (length = n_subjects, or length 1 for broadcast).

n_bins.description: Number of time bins used to summarize the VPC. Default: 10.

pi_level.description: Prediction-interval level for simulated envelopes. Default: 0.90.

quantiles.description: Quantile levels to summarize per time bin. Default: [0.05, 0.50, 0.95].

sigma_add.description: Additive residual error magnitude. Required when error_model='combined'.

function.description: Run per-observation population PK goodness-of-fit diagnostics. Returns population predictions (PRED), individual predictions (IPRED), and weighted residual diagnostics (IWRES, CWRES) for each observation.
function.name: nextstat_pk_gof

doses.description: Per-subject dose amounts (length = number of ETA rows, or length 1 for broadcast).

error_model.description: Residual error model used for GOF diagnostics. Default: proportional.

sigma_add.description: Additive residual error magnitude. Required when error_model='combined'.

function.description: Run normalized prediction distribution error (NPDE) diagnostics for a population PK model. Uses deterministic simulation with an explicit seed and returns per-observation percentiles plus NPDE values, along with overall mean and variance summaries.
function.name: nextstat_pk_npde

doses.description: Per-subject dose amounts (length = n_subjects, or length 1 for broadcast).

error_model.description: Residual error model used for NPDE diagnostics. Default: proportional.

n_sim.description: Number of simulated replicates per observation. Default: 500.

sigma_add.description: Additive residual error magnitude. Required when error_model='combined'.

function.description: Simulate a single clinical PK trial: generate concentration profiles for n_subjects with inter-individual variability and return concentrations, individual parameters, AUC, Cmax, Tmax, and Ctrough for each subject.
function.name: nextstat_trial_simulate

bioavailability.description: Oral bioavailability fraction. Used for oral models only. Default: 1.0.

dose.description: Single dose amount applied to every subject at time 0.

error_model.description: Residual error model for the simulated observations. Default: proportional.

function.description: Run average bioequivalence (ABE) analysis on a 2x2 crossover study. Returns geometric mean ratio, 90% CI, and BE conclusion. Optionally compute power or sample size.
function.name: nextstat_bioequivalence

gmr.description: Assumed geometric mean ratio (for power/sample_size). Default: 0.95.

operation.description: test=run ABE, power=compute power, sample_size=compute N.

ref_values.description: Log-transformed AUC/Cmax for reference formulation (for 'test' operation).

test_values.description: Log-transformed AUC/Cmax for test formulation (for 'test' operation).

function.description: Run Monte Carlo simulation on a fault tree (FTA). Returns P(top event failure), confidence interval, and Birnbaum component importance measures. Supports Bernoulli, uncertain Bernoulli (logit-normal), and Weibull mission-time failure modes.
function.name: nextstat_fault_tree_mc

n_scenarios.description: Number of Monte Carlo scenarios. Default: 1000000.

spec.description: Fault tree specification: {components: [{type, ...}], nodes: [{type:'component', index} or {type:'and'/'or', children}], top_event: idx}. Component types: {type:'bernoulli', p:float}, {type:'bernoulli_uncertain', mu:float, sigma:float}, {type:'weibull_mission', k:float, lambda:float, mission_time:float}.

function.description: Run Cross-Entropy Importance Sampling (CE-IS) on a fault tree for rare-event probability estimation. More efficient than crude MC when P(failure) is very small (< 1e-4). Returns P(failure), SE, CI, number of CE levels, and coefficient of variation. Current CE-IS component support is Bernoulli-only.
function.name: nextstat_fault_tree_ce_is

elite_fraction.description: Elite fraction for CE update. Default: 0.01.

q_max.description: Upper cap for adaptive proposal probabilities. Default: 0.99.

spec.description: Fault tree specification (same node format as nextstat_fault_tree_mc). Current CE-IS component support is Bernoulli-only.

function.description: Evaluate an Emax or Sigmoid-Emax dose-response model. Returns predicted response at given concentrations, or NLL when observed responses are provided.
function.name: nextstat_dose_response

conc.description: Concentration values for prediction or likelihood evaluation.

error_model.description: Residual error model used when obs/response is provided. Default: additive.

obs.description: Observed responses. If provided, the tool returns NLL instead of predictions.

sigma.description: Primary residual scale used when obs/response is provided. Default: 0.05.

sigma_add.description: Secondary residual parameter: additive SD for combined error or power exponent for power error.

function.description: Analyze competing risks data: compute cumulative incidence functions (CIF), Gray's test for group comparison, or Fine-Gray subdistribution hazard regression.
function.name: nextstat_competing_risks

conf_level.description: Pointwise confidence level for CIF intervals. Used when operation='cif'. Default: 0.95.

function.description: Run an event study (dynamic DiD) with leads and lags around treatment. Returns period-specific treatment effects and confidence intervals for parallel trends testing.
function.name: nextstat_event_study

treat_time.description: Treatment onset time for each entity (null if never treated).

function.description: Fit a GARCH(1,1), EGARCH(1,1), or GJR-GARCH(1,1) volatility model to a return series. Returns estimated parameters (omega, alpha, beta, and model-specific terms), log-likelihood, conditional variances, and standardized residuals.
function.name: nextstat_garch_fit

returns.description: Return series (e.g. log-returns of asset prices).
